name: eyebrow
title: Eyebrow
description: The mono uppercase label that sits above Lantern headings.

name: navbar
title: Navbar
description: The Lantern site header: diamond mark, name and outlined tag, nav links and a bordered call to action. On phones the links move into a sheet behind a menu button.
usage:
<Navbar>
  <NavbarBrand href="/">
    <NavbarMark />
    lantern
    <NavbarLabel>Hub</NavbarLabel>
  </NavbarBrand>
  <NavbarLinks>
    <NavbarLink href="/directory" active>Directory</NavbarLink>
    <NavbarCta href="/publish">Publish a hub</NavbarCta>
  </NavbarLinks>
  <NavbarMobile>
    <NavbarLink href="/directory" active>Directory</NavbarLink>
    <NavbarCta href="/publish">Publish a hub</NavbarCta>
  </NavbarMobile>
</Navbar>
notes: NavbarBrand, NavbarLink and NavbarCta accept asChild, so you can pass a framework Link.
NavbarMobile shows below the md breakpoint. Pass it the same links as NavbarLinks. Following a link closes the sheet.

name: stat
title: Stat
description: The numbers strip from the Lantern site: large orange figures with a muted caption, split by dividers and stacked on mobile.
notes: StatGroup renders a description list. Put StatLabel before StatValue in the markup so screen readers read the term first; the value is shown on top visually.

name: status-dot
title: Status Dot
description: A small glowing dot for online, running, error and offline states. Pulses by default.

name: terminal
title: Terminal
description: The in-game terminal window from the Lantern hero: title bar, address line, prompt lines, output and a blinking cursor.

name: button
title: Button
description: Orange primary actions and quiet outlined secondaries, with sizes, icons and link rendering.

examples.name: button-states
examples.title: Loading, disabled and as a link

name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: A square toggle for yes or no choices, with checked, indeterminate and disabled states.
notes: Pass checked="indeterminate" to show a dash, for example on a select-all box when only some rows are checked.

name: field
title: Field
description: Building blocks for accessible forms: labels, descriptions, errors, fieldsets and legends in vertical, horizontal or responsive layouts.
usage:
<FieldGroup>
  <Field>
    <FieldLabel htmlFor="name">Site name</FieldLabel>
    <Input id="name" />
    <FieldDescription>Shown in the directory.</FieldDescription>
  </Field>
  <Field orientation="horizontal">
    <Switch id="online" />
    <FieldLabel htmlFor="online">Keep site online</FieldLabel>
  </Field>
</FieldGroup>
notes: Set data-invalid on a Field and aria-invalid on its control to show an error. FieldError takes children or an errors array, such as the output of a schema validator.
Wrap a horizontal Field in a FieldLabel to turn a radio or checkbox into a selectable card.
orientation="responsive" stacks on narrow containers and goes side by side once the parent FieldGroup is wide enough.

name: input
title: Input
description: A single-line text field for text, email, passwords and files, with invalid and disabled states.

name: input-group
title: Input Group
description: An input or textarea with icons, text prefixes like hub://, and inline buttons attached inside one border.
notes: Addons take align="inline-start", "inline-end", "block-start" or "block-end". Clicking an addon focuses the input.

name: input-otp
title: Input OTP
description: A row of single-character slots for pairing codes and one-time passwords, with paste support.
usage:
<InputOTP maxLength={6}>
  <InputOTPGroup>
    <InputOTPSlot index={0} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={1} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={2} />
  </InputOTPGroup>
  <InputOTPSeparator />
  <InputOTPGroup>
    <InputOTPSlot index={3} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={4} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={5} />
  </InputOTPGroup>
</InputOTP>
notes: Built on the input-otp package by Guilherme Rodz. Use the pattern prop to limit which characters are accepted.

name: label
title: Label
description: An accessible label for form controls.

name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: A set of options where exactly one can be picked, navigable with the arrow keys.
notes: For choice cards, wrap each item in a Label and style the checked card with has-data-[state=checked]. The Field component does this for you with FieldLabel.

name: select
title: Select
description: A dropdown for picking one value from a list, with groups, labels, icons and full keyboard support.
usage:
<Select>
  <SelectTrigger className="w-48">
    <SelectValue placeholder="Pick a theme" />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectItem value="lantern">Lantern</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="moss">Moss</SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>

name: slider
title: Slider
description: Pick a number or a range by dragging square thumbs along a track, or with the arrow keys.
notes: Pass two values to get a range with two thumbs. Give the slider an aria-label or aria-labelledby.

name: switch
title: Switch
description: An on and off control for settings that take effect right away.

name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: A multi-line text field that grows with its content, with invalid and disabled states.

name: toggle
title: Toggle
description: A button that stays pressed, for switching a single tool or view on and off.

name: toggle-group
title: Toggle Group
description: A row of toggles joined together, allowing one or many to be pressed.
usage:
<ToggleGroup type="single" variant="outline" defaultValue="left">
  <ToggleGroupItem value="left" aria-label="Align left">
    <AlignLeftIcon />
  </ToggleGroupItem>
  <ToggleGroupItem value="right" aria-label="Align right">
    <AlignRightIcon />
  </ToggleGroupItem>
</ToggleGroup>

name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Stacked questions that open one panel at a time, with a rotating chevron and orange open state.
usage:
<Accordion type="single" collapsible>
  <AccordionItem value="a">
    <AccordionTrigger>What is Lantern?</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>A small web for Minecraft servers.</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>

name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A round player portrait with an image and mono initials as the fallback. Group several into an overlapping stack.

name: badge
title: Badge
description: Small mono labels, including the square outlined tag used for HUB and DEV.

name: card
title: Card
description: A panel with header, content and footer slots, plus the grid-patterned art banner from the Lantern directory.

name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: Mono key caps for keyboard shortcuts. KbdGroup lines several keys up with even spacing.

name: separator
title: Separator
description: A one-pixel rule in the border color, horizontal or vertical.

name: table
title: Table
description: A plain, responsive table with mono uppercase column heads, hover rows, a footer and a caption. Scrolls sideways on narrow screens.

examples.name: table-compact
examples.title: Compact data with a footer total

name: alert-dialog
title: Alert Dialog
description: A modal that interrupts to confirm an important action. It does not close on outside click, so the reader has to choose.
usage:
<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
    <Button variant="destructive">Unpublish site</Button>
  </AlertDialogTrigger>
  <AlertDialogContent>
    <AlertDialogHeader>
      <AlertDialogTitle>Unpublish site?</AlertDialogTitle>
      <AlertDialogDescription>Visitors will see a dead link.</AlertDialogDescription>
    </AlertDialogHeader>
    <AlertDialogFooter>
      <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
      <AlertDialogAction variant="destructive">Unpublish</AlertDialogAction>
    </AlertDialogFooter>
  </AlertDialogContent>
</AlertDialog>
notes: AlertDialogAction takes variant="destructive" for a filled red confirm button.

name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: A modal window over a dimmed backdrop, for short forms and focused reading. Focus is trapped inside and Escape closes it.
usage: Edit profile. Change how you appear on the network.
notes: The orange period after the title is a Lantern touch you add in the title content. It is not forced by the component.
Pass showCloseButton={false} to DialogContent to hide the corner close button.

name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown Menu
description: A menu of actions opened from a button, with labels, separators, shortcuts, checkbox and radio items and submenus.

name: hover-card
title: Hover Card
description: A preview card that opens when a pointer rests on a link, such as a creator profile behind a username.
notes: Hover cards are for sighted pointer users. The trigger link should still lead somewhere useful on its own.

name: popover
title: Popover
description: A small floating panel anchored to a trigger, for quick settings and short forms.

name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: A dialog that slides in from an edge of the screen, for settings panels and mobile navigation.
usage:
<Sheet>
  <SheetTrigger asChild>
    <Button>Open</Button>
  </SheetTrigger>
  <SheetContent side="right">
    <SheetHeader>
      <SheetTitle>Server settings</SheetTitle>
      <SheetDescription>Where your hub is hosted.</SheetDescription>
    </SheetHeader>
  </SheetContent>
</Sheet>
notes: Set side to top, right, bottom or left. Left and right sheets take three quarters of the screen on phones and cap at 24rem on larger screens.

name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A dark label in small mono type that appears on hover or keyboard focus. Good for naming icon buttons.
notes: Each Tooltip brings its own provider. Wrap a group in TooltipProvider to share the open delay so moving between buttons shows the next tooltip instantly.
Tooltips do not show on touch screens. Keep an aria-label on icon-only buttons.

name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: Shows where a page sits in the site, in small mono uppercase with chevron separators.
notes: The collapsed example uses the Dropdown Menu component, which you install separately.

name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Page links with previous and next controls. The current page gets an orange outline.
notes: The Prev and Next words hide on phones to leave room for the page numbers.

name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Mono uppercase tabs with an orange underline on the active tab, plus a boxed variant for switching between panels.
notes: Set variant="boxed" on Tabs to get the segmented style. The list and triggers pick it up automatically.
The tab list scrolls sideways when there are more tabs than fit on a phone.

name: alert
title: Alert
description: An inline callout with an icon, title and description. Default, success, warning and destructive variants each carry a colored left edge.
usage:
<Alert variant="warning">
  <TriangleAlert />
  <AlertTitle>Low fuel</AlertTitle>
  <AlertDescription>Drop coal in the turtle.</AlertDescription>
</Alert>

name: empty
title: Empty
description: An empty state with an icon in a grid-patterned square, a display title that ends in an orange period, a short description and actions.
usage:
<Empty>
  <EmptyHeader>
    <EmptyMedia>
      <Bot />
    </EmptyMedia>
    <EmptyTitle>No turtles yet</EmptyTitle>
    <EmptyDescription>Pair one to see it here.</EmptyDescription>
  </EmptyHeader>
  <EmptyContent>
    <Button>Pair a turtle</Button>
  </EmptyContent>
</Empty>
notes: EmptyTitle adds the orange period itself, so write the title without one.

name: progress
title: Progress
description: A thin orange bar on a dark 2px to 6px track, modeled on the turtle fuel gauge.
notes: Use size="sm", "default" or "lg" for a 2px, 4px or 6px track. Pass indicatorClassName to recolor the bar, for example bg-destructive when a value is low.

name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: A pulsing placeholder block to hold space while content loads.

name: sonner
title: Sonner
description: Toast notifications from the sonner package, dressed in Lantern colors with a hard offset shadow and lucide status icons.
notes: Mount <Toaster /> once in your root layout, then call toast() from any client component. The toaster is always dark, so it does not need next-themes.

name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: A spinning orange loader, plus a block spinner that pulses three squares like a terminal waiting on a reply.
notes: Both spinners announce themselves with role="status" and the label Loading. Inside a button that already says what is happening, pass aria-hidden and clear the role.
